model_name: HistGradientBoosting+sigmoid_calibration (tuned, v3 stellar params, + catalog crowding, + stellar variability)
note: Gaia DR3 astrometric binary indicators. Validated +0.0142 over 12 bootstraps, CI [+0.0124, +0.0168], 12/12 at MDE; availability-trap gate passed (AUC(avail) 0.5069/0.5054 vs 0.3775 for the closed CTL trap); NSS eclipsing bit confirmed zero occurrences so the signal is astrometric/spectroscopic, not a restatement of the EB label.
promotion_note: Second deployed model change. Added five stellar variability / activity features computed from the RAW (pre-flatten) light curve. Frozen test AUC 0.9208 -> 0.9300. Resampled over 12 training bootstraps: +0.0100 (sd 0.0014), positive 12/12, clearing 12/12, at/above MDE 8/12; 2-min subset +0.0097. Nested CV pooled out-of-fold 0.9295 -> 0.9389 (delta +0.0094, CI [+0.0064, +0.0129]). Brier 0.0879 -> 0.0832, ECE 0.0417 -> 0.0365. Controls passed: sky held constant +0.0098 (12/12), missingness-only indicator +0.0000 (0/12), and a combined worst-case arm holding sky, availability and population all constant at once +0.0087 (12/12 positive, 9/12 clearing). Deployed by manual offline swap, NOT the live promotion gate, which raises ValueError across a feature-set change.
raw_lightcurve_dependency: var_* features are computed from RAW pre-flatten light curves (data/known_lightcurves*, data/unknown_lightcurves*, data/retrain_pipeline/raw), NOT data/processed*. 02_preprocess.py savgol-flattens over ~13.4 h, which removes the multi-day rotational signal these features measure. See code/experiments/variability_features.py.
